definitions.explanation: The nausea and vomiting some pregnant people experience, typically in the first trimester. Despite the English name, it can occur at any time of day.

examples.japanese: つわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
つわり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とれない。
examples.english: I can't eat because of morning sickness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧つわり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされた→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: My wife suffered from severe morning sickness in early pregnancy.

notes:
Almost always written in hiragana. The kanji form {悪阻|つわり} exists but is rare outside medical contexts. Symptoms typically appear around weeks 5–6 of pregnancy and ease by around week 16.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: morning sickness is severe
- つわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧: morning sickness is mild
- つわり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer from morning sickness
- つわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: morning sickness begins
- つわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|おさ}まる→治まる：27790_osamaru⟧: morning sickness eases

USAGE:
Used both by the person experiencing it and by family/medical staff discussing it. Neutral register — appropriate in everyday conversation and medical settings alike.
